description: SandDance demovote: 24,669 geographic records morph between a US map, regional unit bars and 3D geographic stacks, colored by education. Historical sample data from Microsoft Research SandDance (MIT); not current demographic estimates.

text.signal: layout === 'map' ? 'Education across 24,669 places' : layout === 'stacks' ? 'Places by region and education' : ''

x.signal: layout === 'geo-stacks' ? datum.geoColumn * 6 * unit : layout === 'map' ? datum.mapX - 1.4 * unit : scale('region', datum.region) + ((datum.rank-1) % columns) * tileWidth

y.signal: layout === 'geo-stacks' ? datum.geoRow * 6 * unit : layout === 'map' ? datum.mapY - 1.4 * unit : 330 - ceil(datum.rank / columns) * tileHeight

tooltip.signal: {Place: datum.place, State: datum.state, Region: datum.region, Education: datum.education + "%", "Sample ID": datum.id}
